summary: Tested Emergency Contacts & SOS Alert endpoints in /app/backend/server.py. All 16 pytest tests passed (100%). Covered contact CRUD (create/list/update/delete) with priority-based sorting, alert logging with top-priority contact lookup, alert with lat/long, alert for device with no contacts (top_contact null), and Pydantic validation (missing name -> 422, non-existent ids -> 404, missing device_id in alert -> 422). Persistence verified via Create->GET and Update->GET flows. No mongo _id leaks observed. Frontend not tested per request.
critical_code_review_comments: EmergencyContactUpdate inherits from EmergencyContactBase and requires name/phone even if the caller only wants to change priority. Consider making Update fields Optional so partial updates are possible (not blocking; PUT semantics allow full replace).
create_emergency_contact stores datetime objects and returns the same dict; FastAPI serializes datetime to ISO strings automatically so the response is fine. No _id issues observed.
seed_data_creation: Test data is created with TEST_sos_* / TEST_empty_* device_ids and cleaned up in module teardown fixture (deletes all remaining contacts for the test device).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Emergency endpoints stable. Regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_emergency.py. If UI is later added, expected top_contact logic: server sorts contacts by (priority asc, created_at asc) and returns the first as top_contact regardless of the contact_id passed in the alert body.
